selectedHeroImage.title: Ivy Estate Bhopal Premium Entrance Gateway
selectedHeroImage.description: Landscape photo showcasing the landscaped main entry avenue and gated columns under clear blue sky.
selectedHeroImage.selectionRationale: Chosen over alternative candidate ground photos because it represents a high-value physical entrance gate view, establishing instant trust and credibility for high-end residential buyers. The sky composition in the top half allows for clean overlay text legibility, and the green landscaping complements the primary Ivy Green theme perfectly.

alternativeCandidates.rejectionReason: Good wide visual, but colors are slightly washed and the resolution ratio has a tighter crop height, which limits text layout margins above the fold.

This is an architectural diagram layout sheet. While highly informative, it lacks the real-world ground credibility of a physical photo for initial above-the-fold emotional impact. It is deferred to the Layout / Plots section.
